title: Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply Refer-a-Neighbor Program Terms
content:
Refer-a-Neighbor terms for Residential Electricity Supply. A referring customer earns a bill credit for each qualifying referral. The program figures are the same on every plan:

| Plan | Referral credit per qualifying referral (USD) | Maximum referral credits per calendar year | Completed cycles the referred agreement must reach | Referrer's agreement must be active on the posting date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 50.00 | 10 | 2 | yes |

**Terms in brief.**

1. The referral credit of the plan is 50.00 USD per qualifying referral.
2. A referring customer may receive no more than 10 referral credits in one calendar year.
3. A referral qualifies once the referred customer's agreement reaches 2 completed billing cycles.
4. On every plan the referring customer's agreement must be active on the posting date for the referral credit to post.
